job.job_description:
Design and develop generative models such as GANs, VAEs, and Transformers for various applications.


Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI models into larger systems and products.


Develop and maintain large-scale data pipelines and architectures to support model training and deployment.


Conduct research and experimentation to improve existing models and develop new ones.


Work closely with engineers to deploy models in production environments.


Stay up-to-date with industry trends and advancements in AI and machine learning.
